name: HH breakout 10 — fast volatility-adjusted channel break (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same Donchian channel-break convexity but on a FAST 1h clock, which is a genuinely different regime — intraday breaks catch hours-to-days trends, not weeks, so the counterparty and the trade population differ (intraday range-faders and passive quote-sitters rather than swing mean-reverters). The volatility normalization is preserved via an atr floor (only take breaks where true-range has widened) plus an adx trend floor to skip chop, and bb_width ABOVE a floor to demand concurrent band expansion so we are not buying a channel high inside a dead coil. Enter long on a range_position break with all three energy filters. bar_size 1h. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the fast break cannot overcome its far higher fee frequency (net-of-fees profit factor <1.2 on holdout), OR if removing the atr/bb_width expansion filters does not degrade it (the energy confirmation is decorative), OR if it fails to beat buy-and-hold net of fees, OR if the edge is BTC/ETH-only and evaporates on alts per-symbol.
catalyst: fast channel-high break with concurrent band + true-range expansion
